derivation.below_surface_policy: exclude levels with pressure greater than surface pressure
derivation.missing_value_policy: reject masked or non-finite source values

independent_reference.role: validation oracle only; no runtime or build dependency
independent_reference.roundoff_policy: negative off-diagonal rates no smaller than -1e-10 s-1 are clipped only while deriving reference mass-flux profiles

observation_source.campaign: Tropical Warm Pool International Cloud Experiment
observation_source.provider: U.S. Department of Energy ARM / NCAR CCPP-SCM
